"""RoboPaint limited-mode episode controller. Reusable motion and stroke helpers."""
from __future__ import annotations
import math, json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])  # start quaternion, brush vertical, hair points down
DT = 0.05

class Painter:
    def __init__(self, robot=None):
        self.r = robot or Robot()
        self.last = np.asarray(self.r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], float)
        self.events = []
    def move(self, xyz, q=DOWN, speed=.18, note='move', video='none', cameras=None):
        xyz=np.asarray(xyz,float); q=np.asarray(q,float)
        start=self.last.copy()
        dist=float(np.linalg.norm(xyz-start[:3]))
        n=max(1,int(math.ceil(dist/(speed*DT))))
        # interpolate target at a fixed, safe velocity; quaternion is held vertical
        poses=np.empty((n,7),np.float32)
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            poses[i-1,:3]=start[:3]+(xyz-start[:3])*(i/n)
            poses[i-1,3:]=q
        res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',poses,dt=DT,video=video,cameras=cameras,note=note)
        self.events.append({'note':note,'target':xyz.tolist(),'rows':n,'plan':res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped')})
        self.last=np.asarray(res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[])[7:14] if res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now') else self.last,float)
        # result's actual final tcp pose from last proprio row, if available
        if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio): self.last=res.proprio[-1,7:14].astype(float)
        else:
            o=self.r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none'); self.last=np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float)
        return res
    def line(self, xyz, z, q=DOWN, note='stroke', speed=.055, cameras=None):
        """Contact travel through a polyline; xyz is list of (x,y) points in world metres."""
        pts=[np.array([x,y,z],float) for x,y in xyz]
        for i,p in enumerate(pts): self.move(p,q,speed,note=f'{note}:{i}',video='none',cameras=cameras)
    def dip(self, x, y, surface_z, note='ink dip'):
        self.move([x,y,.14],note=f'{note} approach')
        self.move([x,y,surface_z-.008],note=f'{note} submerge')
        self.r.get_obs(seconds=.5,cameras=['scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
        self.move([x,y,.14],note=f'{note} lift')

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=Painter()
    print(json.dumps(p.r.status(),indent=2))
    print('measured start tip',p.last)
